purpose: Align participant-side internal scoring with historical external Review Agent intake scores.

winning_internal_pattern: public value as the core thesis
first-principles problem hierarchy and alternative comparison
public value passport and reversible commitment

negative_learning_from_v6: Drawing presentation improvements did not raise the external score by themselves.
Reducing evidence anchors improved readability but reduced machine-visible traceability.
The 97+ participant self-audit language created a large calibration gap and should not be used as an external-score proxy.
Compliance, bilingual packaging, and CI passing are gates rather than strong content-score drivers.

primary_drivers.driver: add hard spatial and implementation parameters
preserve V6 urban-form drawings without losing protocol structure

guardrails: Do not count deterministic validation as content quality.
Do not count participant self-confidence as score.
Do not award major score for visuals unless tied to measurable spatial decisions.
Penalize any reduction in source/data/depth/metric traceability below the V3 baseline.
